name: TPU v5 Tensor Core Reverse Engineering

mentions.name: TPU v5 Tensor Core Reverse Engineering
mentions.description: A reverse-engineering effort documenting the tensor core on Google's TPU v5 at the instruction level, publishing findings on undocumented TPU architecture as a potentially viable alternative to Nvidia GPUs for machine learning.
mentions.problem: TPUs could be a viable alternative to Nvidia GPUs for machine learning, but their architecture remains largely undocumented.
